title: "invalid_initial_view"
description: "The `initialView` passed to `actorClient(...).create()` does not match the view schema."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** The `initialView` passed to `actorClient(...).create()` does not match the view schema.

**How to fix it:** Pass the view the server rendered for this caller (its role's view, e.g. from `getSnapshot`); the message names each wrong field.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
